sentences: Activated charcoal may help after some recent oral ingestions when the substance binds to it and the person is fully alert enough to swallow safely.
It does not bind every toxin, can adsorb necessary medication, and creates aspiration risk in somebody who is vomiting, sedated, seizing, or unable to protect the airway.
Poison control may be useful when the substance, combination, delayed risk, or value of charcoal is unclear.
I do not treat it as a mandatory ritual; usefulness varies by country and by whoever answers.
It is decision support, not first aid.
